Perfect for young readers who love both reading and listening to beautiful stories, this set promises hours of imaginative adventure and valuable life lessons.

Whether you prefer the magic of printed pages or the convenience of an audio CD, this package offers a complete experience that combines stunning storytelling with educational themes surrounding friendship and self-discovery.

Beyond simply enjoying beautiful tales, the narratives are structured to teach important life skillsâhelping children understand friendship dynamics, boosting self-confidence, and recognizing their unique talents.

Each volume features two complete stories, beautifully embroidered onto classic margins, adding an extra layer of charm and educational value to the printed word.
